scope: JARVIS plan B visual perception and pointing-to-look prototype

face_detection.notes: Primary-face selection, smoothing, and short-loss retention passed.

pointing_detection.notes: Index-finger direction and point confidence passed in live camera testing.

horizontal_pointing_control.notes: Both directions passed. A 2-degree command was swallowed by mechanical deadband; 3 degrees was effective.

object_naming.model_reply_example: 画面中央最明显的物体是一支白色电动牙刷，呈细长圆柱形；我没有移动机械臂。
object_naming.trigger: After the bounded pointing gesture and a 1.2 second settling delay.

known_limitations: The camera-to-table 3D ray intersection and IK gaze are not yet enabled.
Vertical control is a conservative fixed 6-degree pulse rather than continuous servoing.
Object naming assumes the target is near the camera center after the bounded turn.
Success-rate statistics across repeated physical trials still need to be collected.
